decision: retain exact snapshot rollback while measuring bounded coordinator failure-path scaling through 5000 missions

reviews.correctness: Use the real MissionCoordinator failure path and preserve exact rollback invariants; do not replace rollback representation before a measured need exists.
reviews.robustness: Require both 1000- and 5000-mission measurements for growth evaluation and fail closed if either is missing, while retaining ghost-state and fail-closed poisoning assertions.
reviews.latency_resources_regression: Report p95 microseconds per mission and a 1000-to-5000 growth ratio. Accept approximately linear growth with bounded headroom; avoid mutation-delta complexity until the measured failure path exceeds the lab budget.

alternatives.rejected: larger correctness and regression surface without evidence that exact snapshot rollback is the limiting bottleneck
insufficient evidence about scaling as the queue approaches a more substantial lab workload
poor CI predictability and unnecessary CPU/memory consumption

qa: Measure failed enqueue and failed claim at 10/100/1000/5000 missions, record p50/p95/max and p95 microseconds per mission, and fail if the 1000-to-5000 p95 growth ratio exceeds the explicit bound.
lesson: Optimize rollback representation only when the same seeded failure path demonstrates materially worse-than-linear scaling or misses an explicit target budget.
